what_i_changed: Aligned SSOT, ADR-0003, D0 PRD, README, and CONTRIBUTING to `>=22.18 <25`, Node 22/24 validation, and unsupported Node 20. Updated runtime-contract assertions and added TypeScript compiler/lockfile support.
how_it_takes_the_required_approach: `npm test` now compiles TypeScript with `tsc` before testing, emits `dist/node20-tests/...js`, and executes that JavaScript artifact. This deliberately adds the build step, TypeScript devDependency, and emitted artifact surface previously rejected.
